newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 1.24 pct - Fipe.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 1.24 pct - Fipe.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 1.24 percent between June 6 and July 7, down from 1.42 percent in the previous four-week period, a Fipe official said.
The official said lower pressure on food and clothing prices contributed to a slowing in the price index, which measures costs in the city of Sao Paulo.
He gave the following breakdown of the Fipe weighted index for the period.
- Food 0.71 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
